diagnostics.finding: Six of seven native cases passed including full 50 MP. The strict blocked-native installation case found that the shared worker imported the correction WASM URL module. A dedicated data-only database worker removes that dependency; the no-native/no-DTD-request test is unchanged.

The first actual whole-file native reference exposed the pinned upstream legacy frame collapse. Owned routing now isolates actual lfLens cohorts; independent references select explicitly authored expected physical frames and retain the incorrect legacy result diagnostically. Different frame coefficients, independent family frames, global inferred focal range and none-cohort barriers are tested without loosening zero-error checks.

Repeated-coordinate investigation found both conflicting calibration data and identical repeated declarations. Only identical native-effective points normalize with a source notice; complete original XML is retained. Unsupported projections and conflicting/malformed records remain explicitly unavailable.

coverageLimits: Exact synthetic pixels do not establish physical-camera/color/noise quality, peak memory, sustained 60fps or a physical-device matrix.
Accepted working composition remains sRGB8; original source resolution and byte content are retained.
Catalog/source metadata and recorded shooting values are declarations, not authenticated measurements.
Camera/lens suggestions require explicit review and are not native automatic Lensfun FindLenses selection.
No paid call, account, cloud upload, new isolated file/native/network privilege, browser/headless synchronization or arbitrary original-image cap is introduced.
The complete original implementation-roadmap objective including T23/T24 remains active.
